Reclaimable flows will go through existing preliminary, primary, and secondary (trickling filter solids contact) treatment before being pumped to GWRS.
Build a Plant 2 effluent pump station that will convey approximately 50-85 MGD of secondary effluent from Plant No. 2 trickling filter solids contact process to the GWRS Facility.
Build a 6 MG equalization storage tank at Plant No. 2 to store secondary effluent during peak day flows and be returned to the system during low flow periods to maintain a constant flow to the GWRS.
After the GWRS Final Expansion, the activated sludge treatment process will treat only SARI and side-stream flows.
